entities.name: Pedro García Naranjo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Manuel García Naranjo was a Peruvian Catholic priest who served as the 26th Archbishop of Lima from 1908 to 1917. As an educator, he placed special emphasis on improving priesthood education provided at the Seminary of Lima. Under his episcopate, the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru was founded in 1917.
